method: tools/eps/compare.py contact sheets (atlas procedural face vs converted GOV.UK EPS), read by eye on 2026-11-23; 'pass' means the EPS is the same sign as the SI 2016 caption and diagram. Sheets are gitignored (qa/renders/eps/).

verdicts.2016-check: EPS pictogram differs from the face traced from SI 2016; check the 2016 diagram page before using (treated as a conflict)
verdicts.check: identity of the EPS against the 2016 diagram not confirmed on the contact sheet
verdicts.composite: signal head or equipment assembly (aspects, push-button unit), not a fixed sign face; stays procedural
verdicts.fail: EPS differs from SI 2016 in a way that rules it out (extra or missing element); procedural or placeholder kept
verdicts.matches-2016: EPS matches the SI 2016 page, but the face stays procedural/placeholder (value set per site, or an owner-held decision)
verdicts.outdated: EPS is the superseded 2002 face; SI 2016 (si_page) wins and the procedural face is kept; the note records the difference
verdicts.owner-ruling: the owner ruled both SI 2016 alternatives are drawn as separate faces; the EPS shows one only
verdicts.pass: EPS shows the same sign as the SI 2016 diagram caption and the atlas face (contact sheet); for a family outside the fixed-pictogram set (e.g. InfoBlue), 'pass' also confirms the face is a fixed pictogram with no per-site wording
verdicts.pass-si2016: EPS eye-checked against the SI 2016 diagram page (si_page) and matches it; settles a crosswalk/renumbering conflict and the EPS is used
verdicts.raster: converted EPS carries an embedded raster image; not used as a vector face
verdicts.variable: value, orientation or combination set per site (gradient %, arrow direction, mode list); EPS shows one example
verdicts.wording: wording-led plate or composite; wording stays in our own primitive lettering
